{{Quote|Turn your weapons off stun. Kill the prisoners if you have to.|The trooper to his partner|<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>}}
A '''clone''' served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. He was stationed at the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised himself as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] and infiltrated the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center to uncover a plot to assassinate [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], this [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was on guard in the detention facility along with many other clone shock trooper guards.

After the undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] became involved in a fight with fellow prisoner [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], the clone shock trooper guards tried to intervene but the prisoners seized the moment and attacked them and a [[Riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|prison riot]] ensued. During the fight, a reinforcements squadron of clone troopers arrived from an outside corridor, but they were quickly overpowered and the prisoners managed to escape through the open door. This trooper, along with a fellow one, were also stationed inside the corridors and helped stun the prisoners that came their way, until they received orders to turn their weapons off stun and kill the prisoners if they became too violent.

==Behind the scenes==
The clone first appeared in the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] television series' fourth season, titled "[[Deception]]." He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the actor who portrays all of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers in the series.
